security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Strips secrets out of text before you paste it anywhere.
bundle.longDescription:
Paste a log, a config file or a terminal session. Redactor finds the passwords, API keys, tokens and private keys in it and swaps each one for a placeholder like [REDACTED: Password]. What is left is safe to send to a chat assistant, a ticket or a colleague.

Nothing leaves your machine: there is no network code, no account and no telemetry.
